provenance.alt_text: Left: percent asleep in the light phase against the multiplier applied to the wake threshold, for three recordings. All three rise steeply, D2 from 23 percent at multiplier 0.75 to 89 percent at 1.25. A dashed line marks the approximate published value of 70 percent. Right: bar chart of the swing, 66 points for D2 overnight, 36 for B1 overnight, 22.3 for B1 afternoon.
provenance.transformations: wake threshold multiplied by 0.75 to 1.25 in linear microvolts
provenance.uncertainty: sensitivity sweep, not a confidence interval
